text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While reviewing today's session with Mejiro Dober after training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hold on.
I'm gonna take notes on that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Mejiro Dober
pulled out a manga magazine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gah!? No way, why is this...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, n-never mind that,
let's get back to talking about training...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is lacking focus.
It would be wise to reconsider her race schedule.
